name: Campi Bisenzio (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Campi Bisenzio (a white dog on red) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI CAMPI BISENZIO in black arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Campi Bisenzio, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Campi Bisenzio arms — white dog on red, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI CAMPI BISENZIO arched above the arms
